changelog.title: Canvas 0.3.0
changelog.description:
### Minor Changes

- Add accessible Canvas card creation, protected file/media/web dialogs, drops, undo/redo, and selection copy, cut, paste and duplicate with remapped connectors.
- Reconnect either connector endpoint, follow attached cards, and create a linked text card from empty-space drops.
- Render vault-image group backgrounds with cover, fit and repeat sizing, plus protected undoable replacement and removal.
- Keep note embeds live across source changes, resolve vault-file content and text-card links, stop recursive previews, and provide responsive read-only frames.
- Add scoped navigation shortcuts, fit-all/selection controls, named-group jumps and accessible keyboard help.
- Export full-board or viewport PNG images with quality, transparency and content-privacy options.
- Validate URL-card navigation and offer sandboxed web previews with an external-link fallback.
- Align, distribute, arrange and equalize selected cards as undoable commands.
- Convert text cards into owning-vault Markdown notes while preserving geometry, connectors and undo history.
- Support touch panning, pinch zoom, long-press creation and explicit card selection.

### Patch Changes

- Register Canvas writers with the owning App, await native admission, preserve external edits, and retain failed detached saves. Requires API 0.2.4.
- Validate JSON Canvas before editing and preserve imported dimensions, stacking and extension fields.
- Keep queued saves attached to the original file, serialize writes, and flush before transitions.
- Share theme-resolved card colours, restore screen-reader descriptions, and expose separate keyboard edit actions.
- Flush pending text-card editors before switching, renaming or teardown.
